title: Marketing & Brand Executive
description:
Graduate / Early Career Opportunity Permanent Position LIME Renewable Energy

Build Your Career. Make an Impact. Grow with LIME.

Are you a business, marketing, sports business management or PR graduate looking to put your skills into practice and build a long-term career? Or perhaps you've already gained some professional experience and are ready for your next challenge?

At LIME, we're helping homeowners across the UK reduce their energy bills and embrace renewable energy. We're growing fast, and we're looking for a confident, organised and commercially minded individual to join our marketing team.

We're looking for someone who understands marketing, communicates confidently, takes ownership and knows how to get things done.

The Opportunity

Working alongside our Marketing and Brand Manager, you'll help coordinate and deliver marketing activity across the business.

From campaign planning and brand communications to digital marketing and project coordination, you'll play a key role in keeping activity organised, on track and delivered to a high standard.

This is a varied, hands-on role with genuine responsibility, development and long-term career opportunities.

What You'll Be Doing
- Coordinating marketing campaigns, schedules, deadlines and approvals
- Supporting brand communications and wider marketing activity
- Working with internal teams, agencies and external partners
- Managing marketing projects and keeping activities on track
- Supporting digital marketing and social media coordination
- Monitoring campaign performance and supporting reporting
- Taking ownership of tasks and helping the team deliver results

What We're Looking For

We're interested in graduates and early-career professionals from marketing, business management, sports marketing, sports business, PR or related disciplines.

You'll bring:
- A good understanding of marketing principles and commercial objectives
- Strong organisation, planning and coordination skills
- Confidence communicating with people at different levels
- The ability to manage priorities, solve problems and take ownership
- Excellent attention to detail and a professional approach
- A proactive, positive attitude and the ambition to develop

Relevant experience through employment, internships, placements or marketing projects would be beneficial.

We're open-minded about your level of experience. What matters most is your capability, confidence and fit with our team.

Why Join LIME?
- A permanent role with genuine career progression opportunities
- Hands-on experience across marketing, brand and business communications
- Direct support and development from our Marketing and Brand Manager
- Real responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact
- A supportive, ambitious and fast-growing team
- The chance to build your career in the renewable energy industry

Ready to Grow with LIME?

We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys being part of a team and has the confidence to make things happen.

If you're ambitious, capable and ready to build your future with LIME, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now.
